params.name: Corvane Merlin
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/merlin.mjs (edit that, not this). A two-seat mini VTOL built like a wedge supercar: a knife nose, a cab-forward glasshouse, gull-wing doors hinged on the roof rail, NACA ducts, a louvred engine cover with a roof scoop, four round tail lamps, a wing on stanchions, four ducted fans at the corners where the wheels would be, a pusher between the tail lamps and three feet with mag-lock pucks. 4.6 m long. docs/proposals/road-vtol.md.

parts.name: body
parts.note: The shell. The glass is the loft's own faces, glazed (cabin-merlin.js). Door seams, vents, light bars and trim are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
